verdict.rationale: Recruitee's reference pages at docs.recruitee.com/reference warn users to "watch out when testing the endpoint here," because testing creates real candidates or offers. That indicates an in-page interactive try-it console for live, runnable requests against documented endpoints. Bearer-token setup is documented, and the reference is also exposed as markdown and llms.txt. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the interactive console or code samples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (common paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration that the console works.
